                    # simpler: trace from x up, and from y up, find first meeting point
                    # Use dist
                    px = path_x; py = path_y
                    # remove common suffix except meeting
                    # Find meeting: iterate px from end, py from end, find where they diverge
                    i=len(px)-1; j=len(py)-1
                    while i>0 and j>0 and px[i-1]==py[j-1]:

                    lca = px[i]
                    cyc = px[:i+1] + py[j::-1][1:]
                    # verify it's a simple cycle
                    if len(set(cyc))==len(cyc):
                        return cyc
    return None
